claim: EARS-slotted requirement as the internal ProductSpec representation: trigger, precondition, system, response are mandatory slots so an unfilled slot is both the confidence signal and the next interview question
limitations: EARS was designed for engineered systems; fit to fuzzy business outcomes untested

claim: UNCOVERED as a computed state on every requirement: a ProductSpec cannot be called complete while any requirement lacks a linked acceptance criterion
limitations: Requires acceptance criteria to exist as linkable objects, raising authoring cost

claim: Elicit into slots, emit Gherkin: close the disjointness by making elicitation write into an EARS structure whose temporal clause order maps mechanically onto Given/When/Then
limitations: The bridge is structurally clean but unproven end-to-end; no surveyed system does both

claim: NEEDS-CLARIFICATION markers embedded at the point of ambiguity, each carrying candidate answers, making unresolved intent countable and mechanically gateable
limitations: Nothing prevents a model emitting zero markers by guessing confidently; needs an independent ambiguity detector

claim: Provenance pointer per requirement: every ProductSpec clause links to the client utterance or evidence item that produced it, converting scope disputes from opinion into lookup
limitations: Requires captured discovery evidence; cold-start clients have no corpus

claim: Blocking Accept/Revise gate before any build: a spec the client never explicitly accepted is not a spec, and acceptance baselines the artifact
source: com-b-024 Replit; com-b-014 DOORS Next baselining
limitations: Gate fatigue if conflated with billing approval (Replit's design smell)

claim: Change-scoped spec deltas (ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED against a baseline) so repeat engagements never re-elicit settled requirements
limitations: Nothing validates delta internal consistency or baseline accuracy

claim: Maturity-typed spec artifacts (hypothesis → prd → committed proposal) so the same document graduates rather than being rewritten
limitations: Standard has 275 stars and no ecosystem; adopt ideas not format

claim: Suspect-link propagation: editing a requirement automatically flags dependent acceptance criteria and bindings as suspect, turning change impact into a work queue
limitations: Can generate noise if link granularity is wrong

claim: Example-driven formulation: elicit one concrete example, then generalise into a criterion, instead of asking clients for abstract requirements they cannot articulate
limitations: Generalisation step can overfit a single example

claim: ProductSpec as a typed graph with a document as one rendering, rather than a document with links bolted on
limitations: Graph tooling cost; vendor's own schema was never disclosed

claim: Non-goals as first-class mandatory fields, not prose asides — an unstated non-goal is the most common source of scope dispute
limitations: Clients find non-goals hard to state before seeing something

claim: Technology-agnostic measurable success criteria (SC-###) enforced by grammar, so 'make it feel fast' becomes verifiable without naming an implementation
limitations: Measurability sometimes requires instrumentation the client lacks

claim: Prototype for look-and-feel, ask for data and behaviour: a formal rule deciding when a mockup replaces a question
limitations: Boundary cases (workflow shape) fit neither cleanly

claim: Portable canonical spec format: plain, documented, and readable by something other than Actionist, so a tool's death does not strand the client
limitations: Portability constrains schema richness

claim: Independently testable prioritised user stories (P1/P2/P3) where implementing only the top story still yields a viable slice
limitations: Independence is often aspirational in integrated workflows

claim: Assumptions section as a mandatory artifact region recording every default chosen where the client was silent
limitations: Long assumption lists get skimmed; needs ranking by blast radius

claim: Role-differentiated interrogation as a coverage axis: analyst/architect/QA lenses ask structurally different questions; a spec is incomplete while an axis is unexamined
limitations: Ceremony cost; BMAD's own persona prompts were unverified

claim: Decision trace as a first-class validatable object beside the spec, answering 'why does the build not match what I asked for'
limitations: Discipline decays without enforcement

claim: Client review annotations captured as structured data rather than email, feeding directly into spec revisions
limitations: Clients prefer the channel they already use

claim: Two-tier scope split: durable org conventions vs per-project facts, so client-wide preferences are stated once
limitations: Conflict resolution between tiers must be explicit, not 'generally'

claim: Structured selection over blob-stuffing: spec clauses selectable into a prompt by relevance rather than pasting the whole document and hoping
source: com-b-023 documented degradation in long contexts
limitations: Selection errors silently drop requirements

claim: Acceptance fixtures generated from the spec at acceptance time, becoming the P14 verification input without a second authoring pass
source: parts.json P02 outputs AcceptanceFixtures; cucumber-js two-audience artifact
limitations: Generated fixtures may be shallow; needs human review gate

claim: Spec completeness score gating handoff to P12 composition: named, computed, and refusable rather than a judgement call
source: lane reasoning joining Xray UNCOVERED to the P02→P12 seam
limitations: Thresholds arbitrary until pilot data exists

claim: Implementation-independence linter: reject spec clauses naming a repository, database or framework, enforcing framework invariant 3 mechanically
limitations: Some clients have legitimate stack constraints that must be recorded elsewhere

claim: Outcome statement that survives into acceptance, rejecting task-list-as-spec (which says what will be done, never what must be true afterwards)
limitations: Task lists are more legible to clients; outcome framing needs UX work

claim: Authority clauses in the spec: every side-effecting requirement names who may approve it, inheriting the atom contract's authority family
source: 12-atom contract authority field; industry authority_boundary priors
limitations: Clients under-report real approval practice

claim: Failure-state enumeration as a mandatory spec region (what happens when the date passes, the record is missing, the payment is pending)
source: parts.json P02 owns failure states; Replit reviewer's reminder-date example
limitations: Enumeration is unbounded without a stopping heuristic

claim: Spec-level denominator capture: each requirement carries the volume it must handle, so composition can reject an under-scaled capability early
limitations: Clients often cannot supply volumes without instrumentation

claim: Five-workflow proving harness: validate the ProductSpec schema against five concrete target workflows drawn from different archetypes before declaring it canonical
source: parts.json P02 agent brief ('prove it against five target workflows')
limitations: Five may be too few to expose schema gaps

claim: Industry-vocabulary rendering layer: the same canonical spec renders in the client's own terms (matters, jobs, cases, shipments) without changing the underlying structure
limitations: Mapping table maintenance across 17 industries

claim: Spec diffing at client sign-off: show exactly what changed since the last accepted baseline rather than re-presenting the whole document
limitations: Diff readability for non-technical clients

claim: Evidence-grade labels on spec clauses (client-stated, observed, inferred, assumed) so a reader sees which requirements rest on inference
source: AGENTS.md evidence discipline applied to the spec artifact
limitations: Label inflation if everything is marked client-stated

claim: Refusal path in the spec: an explicit region recording what Actionist declined to build and why, preserving the non-goal decision rationale
source: lane reasoning; sweep-spec candidate admission rule
limitations: Commercially awkward to surface; may belong in an internal view

claim: Regulated-industry spec profile: healthcare/law/mortgage specs must name their excluded data classes as explicit constraints, inheriting the discovery-mode exclusion
limitations: Wider uncertainty must be priced, not hidden

claim: Single-mastering decision recorded in the spec: name once whether the spec or the repo masters acceptance scenarios, rejecting dual-mastering drift
limitations: Mastering choice may differ per client engagement model

claim: Spec-to-prompt compiler with receipts: record exactly which clauses were selected into which build prompt, so a build failure traces to a selection decision
source: lane reasoning joining inn-p02-022 to P12/P14
limitations: Adds a logging surface; receipts must be storable per build

claim: Client-readable acceptance rendering: generate Gherkin as an output artifact but never require the client to author it
source: com-b-044 reject-mandatory-Gherkin finding; cucumber-js stakeholder-readability failure mode
limitations: Generated scenarios can drift from client intent without review

claim: Estimation ranges rather than point estimates where scope is still soft, made honest by tying the range to unresolved slots
limitations: Only meaningful once scope exists; ranges can be gamed

claim: Zero-open-markers release gate: mechanically refuse to promote a spec to composition while any NEEDS-CLARIFICATION or UNCOVERED state remains
limitations: Rigid gate may block low-stakes work; needs a documented waiver path

claim: Spec authored against the 12-atom vocabulary so every requirement declares which atom it instantiates, inheriting that atom's verification and recovery obligations
limitations: Atoms may not cover novel requirements; needs an escape hatch

claim: Acceptance criteria written before implementation options are discussed, preventing the spec from being shaped by what happens to be easy to assemble
limitations: Occasionally the feasible set genuinely should inform scope

claim: Shadow-mode spec generation: draft the spec automatically from discovery, but require human formulation review before it becomes the client-facing artifact
source: oss-a-028 OASIS shadow mode applied to spec authoring
limitations: Review capacity becomes the bottleneck

claim: Contradiction register inside the spec: when discovery produced conflicting requirements, record both with sources rather than silently choosing
limitations: Unresolved contradictions must not reach composition unflagged

claim: Spec expiry: an accepted spec carries a validity window after which client circumstances must be re-confirmed before build
source: com-a-007 content decay; oss-b-044 bi-temporal validity
limitations: Expiry windows arbitrary without engagement data

claim: Minimum viable ProductSpec defined by what composition actually needs, derived backwards from P12's inputs rather than forwards from documentation habit
source: parts.json P02 open question 'what is the minimum ProductSpec'; P12 deps
limitations: P12 contract is itself unsettled in Sprint 1

claim: Per-statement quality gating at authoring time: check each requirement sentence for testability as it is written, making quality and testability the same operation
limitations: The reference implementation's rule set was never published; must be built from scratch

claim: Explicit systems-of-record binding section: the spec names which client system owns each entity, carrying P01's SourceOfTruthConflict findings into composition
limitations: Binding may change during build; needs versioning

claim: Spec artifacts are data, not instructions: content quoted from client documents is escaped so it cannot steer the downstream build agent
limitations: Detection imperfect; needs adversarial fixtures

claim: One-page client-facing rendering of a structurally rich spec, so rigour lives in the schema while the client reads something humane
limitations: Summarisation can hide load-bearing clauses
